elimination.campus_nutty_mug: Peanut butter in smoothies, crushed nuts on bowls: fails Cyrus's allergy (deal-breaker).
elimination.campus_griddle_house: Peanut-free and $, but greasy fried food and no vegetables: misses Brooke's no-grease and fresh preferences (-2 stars).
elimination.campus_sprout_lounge: Fresh and nut-free, but $$ (one tier over budget, -1 star); review says too pricey for students.
elimination.campus_green_bean_cafe: Cafe, $, fresh salads and grain bowls, light, peanut-free kitchen: meets everything.

notes: Each decoy fails exactly one dimension and the reviews state it plainly, so the puzzle is fair but fairly easy once reviews are read.
Green Bean Cafe's reviews say 'feels light' and list fresh salads/grain bowls but never explicitly say 'not greasy'; light is a reasonable inference.
All four venues are cafes, so the cafe craving doesn't discriminate; fine, but it means 'coffee' is never actually checked (only Green Bean mentions coffee).
Maya's 'cafes sneak peanut butter into EVERYTHING' is a nice nudge toward reading reviews; The Nutty Mug name is a giveaway on its own, though I eliminated it from the review text, not the name.
